title: Great lesson AND lunch
text: This was such a fun lesson! You are offered a drink upon arrival which is great since we were nervous! We learned a short flamenco routine and it was a great introduction into the dance style. Also, the paella was absolutely delicious!! Would absolutely recommend as a fun afternoon activity!
author: Michael_M

title: Amazing...
text: The lesson we're amazing and fun. The food however did not include a starter or dessert. With that said the paella was great.
author: Richard_R
